## Use the bundled CLI (macOS and Windows)

Start with `voyager ae inspect --json` (no `--details`) for project/comp IDs.
Use `ae doctor --json` for setup trouble.
On Windows, AE must already be open with no second AE or Render Engine running;
Voyager never launches or closes it, so ask the user. Have them turn on AE Settings >
Scripting & Expressions > "Allow Scripts to Write Files and Access Network", and use
absolute `C:\...` paths for `--project` and `--output`.
"Scripting Plugin is not installed" or no response just after AE starts means
a startup dialog such as Crash Repair Options is still open; nothing is missing.
Ask the user to click OK, then **Continue** (not Safe Mode), then rerun `ae doctor --json`.

For a new project, use `ae new --project CURRENT_PATH --output NEW_PATH.aep`.
`--project` always names the project open now; `ae new` refuses unsaved work
unless an authorized `--discard-unsaved` is explicit.

```sh
voyager ae inspect --project /absolute/project.aep --comp 1 --details --json
voyager ae execute --file edit.jsx --project /absolute/project.aep --input @plan.json --json
voyager ae preview --project /absolute/project.aep --comp 1 --times 0.25,1.5,3.75 --output sheet.png --json
voyager ae render --project /absolute/project.aep --comp 1 --template 'EXACT NAME' --output video.mp4 --json
voyager ae save --project /absolute/project.aep --json
```

Read layers at `result.comp.layers`; property trees use `children`. Truncated
trees are marked: narrow with `--layer ID` or raise `--depth` instead of treating
omitted data as absent.

JSX receives `params`; assign plain data to `result`. Use absolute asset paths.
Edits run in an undo group, without rollback. Use `app.project.itemByID(id)` and
`app.project.layerByID(id)`; check the containing comp. Run AE calls one at a time;
a timeout does not cancel AE, so poll `ae job ID --timeout 60 --json` rather than rerun.

`ae templates --project PATH --json` lists render templates (add `--allow-probe
--comp ID` for an empty queue). `--start`/`--duration` render a segment.

## JSX essentials

- ExtendScript has no JSON global.
- Use property match names, e.g. `ADBE Transform Group`; 2D Rotation is `ADBE Rotate Z`, not `ADBE Rotation`.
- Spatial Position uses one `KeyframeEase` per side; three-component Scale uses three.
- `TextDocument.boxText` and `pointText` are read-only; for a fixed paragraph box use
  `comp.layers.addBoxText([width, height], text)`.
- Key the original Source Text at the start when adding later HOLD cues. Check `expressionError`.
- `app.newProject()` / `app.open()` can raise Save prompts that suppressing dialogs
  does not prevent. Save to an explicit path, or close only authorized disposable work
  with `CloseOptions.DO_NOT_SAVE_CHANGES`.
